articles.title: How to make a payment receipt
articles.summary: Make a payment receipt in Nivesh Sahayak: payer, amount, cash, UPI or cheque details, against which bill, TDS deducted and balance still due.

articles.title: Receipt voucher for an advance, and refund voucher
articles.summary: Record an advance with GST as a receipt voucher (section 31(3)(d)) and its refund voucher in the Nivesh Sahayak receipt maker, with SAC, rate and place of supply.

articles.title: How receipt numbers work
articles.summary: How receipt numbers work in Nivesh Sahayak: RCT series per business, restart every 1 April, change the prefix, and fix a duplicate number.

articles.title: Print, PDF and share a receipt
articles.summary: Print a receipt on A4, A5 or a thermal roll, pick one of 7 designs and copies, save a PDF, or share it on WhatsApp from Nivesh Sahayak.

articles.title: Saved receipts: find, open, copy and edit
articles.summary: Find any saved receipt in Nivesh Sahayak: search the Saved receipts list, open to edit or reprint, copy it as new, set its status.
